name: shot-director
summary: Screenshots from the real game at set times, then quit: the way to see what a change looks like without sitting at the machine.

MODULE.description: The C++ game module the two source files join (the directory under Source/).

adapt: Close the editor, then compile: node Tools/gam3/ue_build.mjs
Nothing to register: the subsystem creates itself when one of its flags is on the command line.

verified.how: Compiled into a fresh C++ project's game module. ue_game.mjs --shots 6,9 --quit 11 --cam ... wrote both PNGs and quit, including on a first run with a multi-second shader hitch. The images were opened and checked. Shipping builds and Windows were not run.
